propositions: _collect_node_ids launches nested pytest collection subprocess without a private --basetemp directory, causing its cleanup to operate on the shared numbered temp root and potentially delete or traverse unrelated run temp trees
pytest session shutdown in cleanup_numbered_dir/rmtree can delete or stall on another concurrent run's temp tree when multiple pytest processes share the same numbered root directory
passing a caller-owned private --basetemp directory to _collect_node_ids prevents cleanup contention while preserving collection selection, stdout parsing, return-code contract, and timeout behavior
the regression test demonstrates that without private basetemp, preexisting sentinel files in the shared numbered root are deleted or traversed; with private basetemp they survive unchanged
